presentation.body: Stado keeps workers, queued work, outcomes, and cleanup state in one operational view. Begin from your existing canonical declarations rather than reconstructing them.
presentation.title: Control the fleet you already have

presentation.body: Select the active Stado dashboard, then import an existing registry-v2 JSON file. Import changes declarations only: it reads no host, starts no workload, and performs no fleet action.
presentation.title: Adopt declarations without touching the fleet

presentation.body: Choose a Stado registry-v2 JSON file. The entire source is validated before mutation; missing declarations are added, existing declarations remain, and differing records stop the import with exact conflicts. Skip keeps an empty usable product.
presentation.title: Import your existing registry

presentation.body: The journey completes only after Stado accepts the merged registry generation. A rejected source or conflict leaves the canonical registry unchanged. You can repeat this action later in Settings.
presentation.title: Accept the canonical registry generation
